name: Running AI on your own laptop

hook_variants.template: That chatbot in your browser? You could run one yourself. Here's how.
{news_title} And yes, models this big can run at home.
Models used on one laptop. That's the change in AI right now.

sections.text: Small models run on your machine. No cloud, no bill, no waiting.
Open models are getting big. One releases with 172 billion parameters.

sections.text: On your side, a small model can still answer, summarize, and help offline. Ollama makes it a one line install.
That line: ollama run. That's the whole tutorial.

sections.text: No cloud needed. Follow for the next AI explainer.
